evidence.description: ISO8601DateFormatter is instantiated every time lastUpdatedDate() is called, which is an expensive operation.

candidates.explanation: Creating a new date formatter instance for every call to a conversion method is inefficient. It is standard practice to reuse a single instance or use a static property to improve performance.
candidates.title: Inefficient DateFormatter instantiation

evidence.description: The class uses several hardcoded numeric values and timestamps to initialize its properties.

candidates.explanation: Hardcoding values like '113016418' or '1604671200' makes the code harder to maintain and less readable. These values should ideally be defined as constants or retrieved from a configuration source.
candidates.title: Hardcoded Magic Numbers

evidence.description: The loop iterates through results and uses a switch statement to manually map values to properties, repeating the same null-coalescing logic for multiple cases.

candidates.explanation: The repetitive pattern of checking for a double value and falling back to the current property value for multiple cases (lines 64-68) indicates a code smell that could be simplified with a more generic mapping approach.
candidates.title: Redundant Logic in Switch Statement
